admission.justification: Negative controls expose loss of expected-old take-back, replacement narrowing and cleanup protection, which could otherwise overwrite concurrent commits or remove protected content while ordinary successful tests stay green.

applicability: Take-back and replacement controls under test.
conditions: The expected-old value is wrong or the selection is terminal.
exclusions: A clean success; no control fires.
statement: Tests catch loss of expected-old take-back, replacement narrowing and cleanup validation.
